LF01_A.copy: LF01 Five Days, Five Pairs — hook image (the fireworks bench)
LF01_A.prompt: Taken at night by her daughter from about 15 feet away with harsh phone flash. A heavy-set plus-size woman (US size 22, about 52 years old, round face, shoulder-length brown hair, tired eyes) sits alone on a theme-park bench. Her sneakers are off and lying on the pavement next to her feet; she is in white socks. On her lap and piled beside her: shopping bags, a child's backpack, a light-up souvenir toy, water bottles, a folded stroller leaning on the bench. Behind her, out of focus, crowds of families walking away toward a faint colorful fireworks glow in the dark sky. Flash makes her look washed out, background dark and grainy. IMPORTANT: her feet are only in white socks; her sneakers are NOT on her feet, they sit untied on the pavement a foot away. The full frame is the photo itself: no app interface, no social media overlay, no captions, no usernames, no text of any kind.

LF01_B.copy: LF01 — alt image (four failed pairs on the hotel carpet)
LF01_B.prompt: Looking straight down at a beige hotel-room carpet with the corner of a bed and a rolling suitcase at the edge. Four pairs of worn women's sneakers lined up in a row, each pair with a strip of masking tape on the carpet in front of it, handwritten in black marker: "DAY 1", "DAY 2", "DAY 3", "DAY 4". Day 1: grey slip-on memory foam sneakers. Day 2: chunky thick-soled cushioned running shoes. Day 3: white and black gym sneakers. Day 4: light grey running shoes with a pointed toe. All generic and unbranded, dusty and scuffed from walking. A folded theme-park map brochure with no logos and a lanyard lie next to them. Warm yellow hotel lamp light.

LF02_A.copy: LF02 The Shoe Graveyard — hook image (the bin)
LF02_A.prompt: A clear plastic storage bin with a lid, sitting on the concrete floor of a cluttered suburban garage next to a lawnmower and paint cans. The bin is stuffed with worn-out women's work shoes: chunky cushioned running sneakers in navy and grey, a pair of black clogs, slip-on memory foam sneakers, white sneakers with collapsed heels, all scuffed, creased and stained from hospital shifts. A strip of masking tape across the lid with "THE GRAVEYARD" handwritten in thick black Sharpie. Single overhead garage bulb, flat dull light.

LF02_B.copy: LF02 — alt image (7:40 a.m. in the parking garage)
LF02_B.prompt: Point of view from the driver's seat of a car parked in a concrete hospital parking garage at early morning. A woman's tired feet in navy compression socks are propped up on the dashboard, legs in navy blue scrub pants. A hospital ID badge on a lanyard and a coffee cup in the cupholder. On the passenger-side floor, a pair of chunky cushioned running sneakers kicked off. Pale dawn light through the garage opening, slightly fogged windshield.

LF03_A.copy: LF03 Wish You Were Here — hook image (her café chair at the bottom of the hill, no person)
LF03_A.prompt: Phone photo taken sitting down at a small round metal café table on a sidewalk at the bottom of a very steep, narrow cobblestone street made of small white and black stones in an old European hillside city at sunset. On the table: an untouched glass of red wine and a phone face-down. Under the table on the cobblestones: a pair of chunky white sneakers, kicked off, one on its side, laces loose. Nobody is wearing them; no feet or people in the foreground. The steep street climbs away from the camera toward old stone castle walls on the hilltop, glowing in the sunset; a few tiny distant people walking up the hill. Pastel tiled buildings, laundry on balconies. Ordinary handheld photo, slightly crooked. No text.

LF03_B.copy: LF03 — alt image (the 'Wish you were here' text over the view he sent)
LF03_B.prompt: Phone photo taken from the top of an old stone castle wall at sunset, looking out over a European city of terracotta rooftops, church domes and a wide river glowing orange, a man's hand resting on the stone wall in the lower corner. Big sky with orange and pink clouds. Slight lens flare. The lower third of the frame is mostly calm sky-colored river and rooftops in shadow.

bubbles.text: I'm 200 feet below you. In my socks.
